Privacy.label: Privacy
Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: HARMONYA MEDICAL processes browsing and contact data transparently, proportionately, and securely.

data.title: Data collected
data.text: We may collect an anonymous visitor ID, viewed pages, clicks, scroll depth, language, referrer, and user agent. Emails and messages are collected only when you enter them in a form.

analytics.title: Audience tracking
analytics.text: Behavioral tracking starts only after you accept via the consent banner. If you decline, no audience measurement is recorded.

emails.title: Email addresses
emails.text: We never automatically retrieve a visitor's email. An email is stored only via the contact form or newsletter, with a checked consent box. It may then be linked to your anonymous journey for better follow-up.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: Under applicable law, you may request access, correction, or deletion of your data by contacting contact@harmonyamedical.com.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: For any privacy question: contact@harmonyamedical.com — Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso.
